source.directorySummary: Provides the file AI plugin contract for bottom-up documentation — Zod-validated schemas for bottomup.generate, bottomup.enrich, bottomup.summarize and bottomup.summary calls plus runtime glue that documents tool usage, dispatches calls to handlers via workspace root, and supplies an in-memory database.

schema.ts.sourceSummary: Defines nullable Zod helpers and BottomupAgentKnowledgeSchema plus FileToolCallSchema/ToolCallSchema discriminated union of bottomup.generate, bottomup.enrich, bottomup.summarize and bottomup.summary with inferred types and skillDescription/skillRules constants.

tooling.ts.sourceSummary: Exports agentInstructions documenting bottomup workflow, executeTool dispatching FileToolCall by type to bottomup handlers via resolved workspace root, and openDb returning an in-memory SQLite Database.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: AI contract and dispatch boundary inside the file-manager facade. Decouples the host BotPlugin/AI runtime from the bottomup implementation in commands/: exposes a validated tool-calling surface for LLM-driven documentation workflows and handles workspace-root resolution and routing to handlers, while commands/ owns execution logic and types/ owns the generic adapter contract. Provides ephemeral in-memory persistence to keep AI invocations stateless and testable.

files.schema.ts: Validation boundary and single source of truth for the AI surface; defines the discriminated union consumed by tooling.ts/executeTool and the BotPlugin registration. Centralizes BottomupAgentKnowledgeSchema and skillDescription/skillRules so prompting, validation, and dispatch share one contract.
files.tooling.ts: Runtime glue that operationalizes schema.ts contracts. Bridges validated FileToolCall dispatch to commands/bottomup handlers via resolved workspace root, publishes agentInstructions for workflow documentation, and provides openDb in-memory SQLite for stateless execution - depends on schema.ts for type safety.
